entities.name: Juniper Order
entities.description: Order of druids and knights who left Kjeldor for Fyndhorn, later relocating to Yavimaya.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker worshipped as a goddess by the order.

entities.description: High Honored druid who led the order late in the Ice Age.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: Kolbjorn's daughter who took his place leading the order.

entities.description: Kaysa's lover and an Advocate of the Order.
